open.heading:
How a year actually
{{runs}}
body: Six steps, repeating. Content is taught, practised, assessed and fed back — and where a subject needs more, the support is named rather than assumed.

cells.label: Learning
cells.value: Taught content, to the CBSE scheme of work.
cells.sub: Taught content following the school’s curriculum, published class by class as PRECEPT.

cells.label: Activities
cells.value: Practical, project and laboratory work alongside it.
cells.sub: Practical, project and laboratory work alongside classroom learning.

cells.label: Assessment
cells.value: Internal assessment through the year; boards at X and XII.
cells.sub: Regular assessment through the academic year, with the CBSE boards at Class X and XII.

cells.label: Feedback
cells.value: Results to parents, and a parent–teacher meeting to discuss them.
cells.sub: Results to parents, and a parent–teacher meeting on the calendar to discuss them.

cells.label: Improvement
cells.value: Remedial support and mentoring where a subject needs it.
cells.sub: Remedial support, mentoring and a retest with published rules, where a subject needs it.

cells.label: Achievement
cells.value: Board examinations, and competitions beyond the school.
cells.sub: Board examinations, and the national programmes the school enters beyond them.

cycle.heading:
Assessment is
{{more than a paper.}}
body: A result is one reading of a year. The school assesses across the whole of it — understanding in the room, application in the laboratory, progress across terms, and the feedback that follows each.

cells.label: Classroom
cells.value: Learning and understanding, every day.

cells.label: Practical
cells.value: Application and experimentation.

cells.label: Progress
cells.value: Continuous academic development.

cells.label: Feedback
cells.value: What happens next, together.

struct.heading:
Our assessment
{{structure.}}
body: Four things the school states about how a year is examined. The marks a promotion turns on are set out in the policy itself rather than paraphrased here.

cells.label: Half-yearly examination
cells.value: A written examination partway through the session, evaluating understanding and academic progress.

cells.label: Annual examination
cells.value: The assessment at the end of the academic session, and the one a promotion turns on.

cells.label: Report card
cells.value: Results reach parents on the report card, and sit in the parent portal between meetings.

cells.label: Retest / improvement
cells.value: Additional teaching and a retest, on a timetable the school publishes in full.

sup.heading:
Support begins
{{where a difficulty appears.}}
body: Every student learns differently. What matters is that each of the four channels below is published by name and has rules attached — so a family can check what happens next rather than hope that something will.

cells.label: Remedial support
cells.value: Additional teaching in the subject that needs it — attached to a subject, not to a student.

cells.label: Mentoring
cells.value: A member of staff who knows the child as a person rather than as a name on a class list.

cells.label: Retest
cells.value: No sooner than ten days after results, two clear days apart, and results inside two and a half weeks.

cells.label: Parent partnership
cells.value: Meetings placed on the session calendar, and a portal carrying reports in between.

conv.heading:
Progress is
{{a conversation.}}
body: Parent–teacher meetings are placed on the **academic calendar for the session**, alongside the examination dates, the terms and the holidays — so a parent knows the date months in advance and can read it against the paper it follows.
Meeting dates sit on the [academic calendar](/academics/academic-calendar/); the wider parent channels are on [Parent Partnership](/academics/parent-partnership/).

cells.value: A mentor who already knows the child sees the change first.

cells.label: Understand
cells.value: The subject, not the student, is identified as the thing that needs work.

cells.label: Support
cells.value: Additional teaching in that subject, before any retest is sat.

cells.label: Improve
cells.value: A retest on a published timetable, and the result declared with the annual one.

close.heading:
Assessment tells us
{{where to go next.}}
body: Learning continues through feedback, support and the opportunity to improve. The school publishes the cycle, the support channels and the retest calendar. It does not publish examination dates, weightings or the promotion threshold — and none is estimated here.
